description: Share one of your Switch Editor projects with a team member by their Switch account email, stop sharing it, or list who has it. A shared project opens for them with its media, its chat history and its renders; they can edit, upload, run the editor brains and render. Only the owner can share or delete. Actions: list (default), share, unshare. Share only when the person named the email and said to share.

action.description: Default list. share grants edit, upload, run and render rights to that email at once; unshare removes them.

email.description: The team member's Switch account email. Required for share and unshare.

name: share_editor_project
title: Share Editor Project
